shortDescription: Slovakia 10 Year Government Bond Yield increased to 4.38%, the highest since March 2011.Over the past 4 weeks, Slovakia 10Y Bond Yield gained 45.20 basis points, and in the last 12 months, it increased 78.60 basis points.
